description.en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy.

description.zh: 自动快照策略的名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). It must support characters in the Unicode letter category, which includes characters from various languages such as English and Chinese.

description.zh:
自动快照策略返回结果分多页展示。

起始值：1。

默认值：1。
description.en:
The page number of the automatic snapshot policy list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页展示返回的自动快照策略时的每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page when automatic snapshot policies are displayed in paging mode.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 要查询的自动快照策略所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policies that you want to query. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。

>不支持默认资源组过滤。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1000.

> Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

description.zh: 自动快照策略的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The tag key of the automatic snapshot policy. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://.

description.zh: 自动快照策略的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The tag value of the automatic snapshot policy. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://.

title.zh: 查询已创建的自动快照策略

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-auto-snapshot-policy-ex --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --auto-snapshot-policy-name TestName --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-aek2kkmhmhs0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2kkmhmhs0000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --AutoSnapshotPolicyId 'sp-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AutoSnapshotPolicyName TestName
